_for: machine/orchestrator consumption; separate machine layer; UI is not source of truth

_split_plan.prompts: derived at runtime from promptBuilder; prompt files are never source of truth

system_invariants: 30 architecture-process stages are preserved as the canonical content model.
Human input: one free-form IDEA, then selection-only questionnaire before G1; after G1 normal path is automatic except execution of HUMAN_TEST.
A model never expands its own authority and never impersonates Owner or Human Tester.
All mutable domain state is versioned in RegistryEntry; hard delete is forbidden.
Graph describes data dependency/provenance; controlFlow describes execution order, loops and waits.
Gates and Definition-of-Done are computed predicates, never manual checkboxes.
Model output is a mutation proposal; only validated atomic commit changes project state.
Consensus of models is not evidence.
Prompts are compiled at runtime from manifest contracts and are not an independent source of truth.

idea_intake.next: automatic stages 1-3 until a stable QST set is ready

questionnaire.branching: JSONLogic over prior selected option IDs
questionnaire.delta_rounds: Allowed only before G1 on normal flow; max from controlFlow.loop_limits.

Producer.can: Создаёт proposals, черновики и ревизии своих артефактов.
Producer.cannot: Не получает автоматически полномочия принимать решения или подтверждать факты.

Reviewer.cannot: Не исправляет reviewed artifact и не закрывает решения.

Synthesizer.can: Объединяет, нормализует и дедуплицирует с сохранением различий и provenance.
Synthesizer.cannot: Не принимает решения только потому, что объединяет материалы.

Decision Closer.can: Закрывает решения в пределах Decision Policy и маршрутизирует остальные.
Decision Closer.cannot: Не выходит за доступный authority class.

Verifier.can: Присваивает epistemic status на основании evidence.

Owner.can: Источник продуктовых полномочий; утверждает решения и baselines, требующие владельца.
Owner.runtime_rule: After IDEA submission, normal participation is selection-only before G1. After G1, Owner is not a normal runtime actor; uncovered scope/authority change halts the pipeline.

Policy Engine.can: Executes deterministic Decision Policy and answer effects; commits only validated mutations.
Policy Engine.cannot: Cannot invent preferences or expand authority.

Human Tester.can: Executes an explicit HTSK test plan and records HRES.
Human Tester.cannot: Cannot change product or architecture through a test result.

Orchestrator.can: Schedules stages, resolves snapshots, invokes adapters, validates, commits atomically, routes waits/failures.
Orchestrator.cannot: Cannot make product or architecture decisions.

A0.meaning: Reversible low-risk decision inside committed scope.

A1.meaning: Decision depends on an external or empirical fact.

A2.meaning: Value/preference decision not derivable from evidence alone.
A2.rule: Before G1 it must be resolved by selection or explicitly deferred non-blocking. After G1 a newly discovered A2 is a product-baseline reopening condition.

A3.meaning: Changes scope, contract, Decision Policy or committed baseline.
A3.rule: Never auto-closed. After G1 normal pipeline halts with SCOPE_CHANGE_REQUIRED.

A4.meaning: Decision/action outside permitted risk or prohibited by policy.

bootstrapDecisionPolicy.description: Safe policy used only before DPL becomes ACTIVE.

rules.A0: MODEL_MAY_PROPOSE; Policy Engine may close only structural/reversible choices explicitly allowed by manifest.

decisionPolicy.source_of_truth: latest non-stale DPL with status ACTIVE
decisionPolicy.normal_path_after_G1: No human approval. Decision Closer may propose; Policy Engine deterministically decides only where DPL contains an applicable rule.
decisionPolicy.baseline_reopen: Owner AEV required; then invalidate dependent baselines and rerun minimal affected product stages.

question_sources: DPL fields required for post-G1 autonomy
questionnairePolicy.effects: Only declared QST option effects may be applied; answer compiler is deterministic.

unknownPolicy.blocking_rule: blocking=true iff unresolved item can change a required REQ, gate predicate, architecture direction, safety/security invariant, or committed baseline.

riskPolicy.critical_requires: explicit mitigation plus applicable DPL authority; otherwise halt

requirements: no semantic merge when consequences differ

changePolicy.on_source_revision: mark transitive dependents stale via provenance refs, create CHG if semantic outcome changes, schedule minimal downstream rerun set

humanTestBoundary.definition: HUMAN_TEST means real-world execution or user/device/product acceptance observation. Only Human Tester may execute it.
humanTestBoundary.before_G1: No HUMAN_TEST. Stage 9 is scenario/model analysis only.
humanTestBoundary.after_G1: Stage 25 may create HTSK. Pipeline waits for HRES, then deterministically materializes EVD(method_kind=HUMAN_TEST).

IDEA.description: Исходная идея пользователя. Единственный свободный текст на входе.

DPL.description: Project-specific Decision Policy, активируемая только через ответы Owner.

PCON.description: Product Concept; отдельный тип, чтобы не смешивать его с Functional Map CAP.

manifest_lint.logic: All stage numbers unique; all role/code/gate/validator refs exist; all schemas parse; status enum exists for every object code; graph has no dangling/duplicate direct edges; cycles require declared loop policy; split-plan keys unique.

object_schema_valid.logic: Validate RegistryEntry; validate payload against objects[code]; status in statusEnums[code]; object_id prefix matches code; content_hash matches canonical payload; additionalProperties policy respected.

typed_refs_exist.logic: Every ObjectRef resolves to exact immutable object_id+version and target is not hard-deleted; referenced code matches entry code.

mutation_permission.logic: Every operation is allowed by active role and stage contract; Reviewer cannot revise reviewed target; model cannot create AEV/HRES/BSL directly.

authority_within_policy.logic: A0/A1 closure matches applicable DPL rule and evidence requirements; A2/A3 closure requires OWNER AEV originating from selected QANS; A4 cannot close.

questionnaire_valid.logic: Selection-only; >=2 unique option_ids; default=null; JSONLogic condition only references prior answers; effects touch only referenced PD/DPL/scope fields and use allowlisted effect types; no hidden free-text input.

answers_valid.logic: Selected option ids exist, cardinality matches SINGLE/MULTI, all required visible questions answered exactly once.

answer_effects_valid.logic: Compiled mutations equal the selected option effects byte-for-byte after canonicalization; creates OWNER AEV; no unselected effect applied.

stage_ready_to_run.logic: Resolve each typed selector against one immutable input snapshot; meet required/min_count/status/version/stale constraints; required gate/baseline is committed.

independence_satisfied.logic: min_runs met; required distinct models met; all runs used identical input snapshot hash; isolated runs did not receive sibling outputs before fan-in.

dod_complete.logic: Evaluate all declared postcondition validators; every finding/escalation has an explicit route; no manual checkbox is source of truth.

gate_checklist_complete.logic: Execute each check validator/params; persisted checklist is only the result cache. pass iff all blocking checks pass.

no_open_blockers.logic: No matching entry has blocking=true and a status listed by the gate's per-code blocking_statuses.

all_required_statused.logic: Every selected object has a status in allowed_statuses; no required CANDIDATE/UNVERIFIED/PENDING remains.

trace_complete.logic: For every in-scope source object there is at least one typed-ref path satisfying required_path and all path entries are non-stale.

package_hash_identical.logic: All independent runs in the fan-out reference identical snapshot_id and snapshot_hash.

baseline_snapshot_valid.logic: All selectors resolve; gate passed on same snapshot; snapshot immutable; BSL content_refs exactly equal resolved selector set; canonical hash matches.

evidence_verifiable.logic: VERIFIED/FALSIFIED EVD has allowed method_kind, artifact_refs when required, exact target refs, executor compatible with method_kind. MODEL_ANALYSIS cannot confer VERIFIED.

human_test_execution_only.logic: Every HUMAN_TEST EVD has HRES+AEV from actor_type HUMAN_TESTER; model/tool runs cannot create HRES or claim HUMAN_TEST execution.

post_g1_autonomy_covered.logic: Every known normal-path decision kind that may occur after G1 maps to AUTO_POLICY or REQUIRE_EVIDENCE with deterministic closer; A2/A3 product/scope changes map to STOP/REOPEN, never silent continuation.

no_unresolved_blocking_findings.logic: No FND with blocking=true and status OPEN remains in scope.

chg_propagated.logic: For each APPLIED CHG, propagated_to covers computed impact_set and no dependent entry on superseded input remains non-stale.

falsified_assumption_has_change.logic: Every FALSIFIED ASM with dependents has an APPLIED/APPROVED CHG or all dependents have been superseded through the same invalidation event.

architecture_leakage_clear.logic: No blocking OPEN FND class=architecture_leakage created by stages 5/8/12 remains.

scope_coverage_complete.logic: Every required in-scope scenario/capability derived from IDEA/closed PD has CAP and at least one REQ; any excluded/deferred scope has explicit PD/UNK with non-blocking status.

direction_rationale_present.logic: Accepted direction references CMP candidates/criteria, has non-empty rationale, and selection is reproducible from active DPL or evidence rule.

adr_trace_complete.logic: Each in-scope REQ has path to accepted AD/ADR; evidence-dependent claims have path to EVD; non-evidence architectural choices have DPL authority path.

graph.source_of_truth: Stages' typed input selectors + provenance refs. Edges below are direct only; transitive edges are derived.

controlFlow.initial_action: Persist IDEA@v1, set workflow_state=RUNNING, run manifest_lint, schedule stage 1.
controlFlow.scheduler: Single-project event-driven scheduler with optimistic revision lock.

WAITING_FOR_SELECTION.entry: At least one required visible QST exists before G1.
WAITING_FOR_SELECTION.allowed_human_action: Submit QANS using option IDs only.
WAITING_FOR_SELECTION.resume: Validate QANS -> create OWNER AEV -> deterministic answer compiler -> commit -> resume recorded stage.

WAITING_FOR_EVIDENCE.entry: Required external evidence adapter unavailable or asynchronous external dependency unresolved.

WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_TEST.allowed_human_action: Execute test plan; submit HRES PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED plus optional observations.
WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_TEST.resume: Create HUMAN_TEST AEV and deterministic EVD, then resume stage 25/26.

abnormal_terminal_or_reopen_states.SCOPE_CHANGE_REQUIRED: A post-G1 A2/A3 product/scope/baseline decision is uncovered by committed PFB/DPL. No model may continue. Owner must explicitly reopen baseline in a new controlled-change run.
abnormal_terminal_or_reopen_states.UNRESOLVABLE: Blocking item has no valid evidence/decision route after loop limit.

rules: Do not invent missing inputs; create/route UNK or FND.
Narrative explanation is ignored by decision logic.
A model never claims Owner or Human Tester identity.
Return only STANDARD_MUTATION_ENVELOPE that validates against exact response schema.
promptBuilder.repair_prompt: Same contract and snapshot; append machine validation errors only. No new scope.

architecture.client: Static HTML or other UI. Presentation only; never stores API secrets and never decides process state.
architecture.orchestrator: Backend/CLI service executes state machine, stage runners, validators, gates, transactions and adapters.
architecture.state_store: Persistent project state + immutable registry versions + event log.
architecture.source_of_truth: Committed project state and this manifest; UI text and model narrative are not source of truth.

startup: open project state with revision lock

transaction.on_conflict: discard proposal and rerun against new snapshot

repair.input: exact validation errors + same input snapshot + same response schema

invalidation.trigger: committed revision/status/evidence result changes semantic dependency
invalidation.algorithm: walk provenance.input_refs forward, mark dependents stale, compute minimal affected stage set, record CHG/invalidation event, reschedule only affected stages
invalidation.baseline_rule: committed baseline becomes superseded only through controlled reopen/commit

security.secrets: runtime-injected from secret store/environment; never in manifest, HTML, prompt logs or registry payloads

budgets.enforcement: before every model/tool call and before fanout

POST /projects.effect: persist IDEA, create project, start orchestrator

POST /projects/{project_id}/answers.effect: validate, create AEV, compile effects atomically, resume

POST /projects/{project_id}/human-tests/.effect: create HRES+AEV, materialize HUMAN_TEST EVD, resume

POST /projects/{project_id}/resume.effect: resume only from recoverable technical/evidence wait state; cannot bypass authority/test waits

toolPolicy.verification_rule: No adapter result can set target VERIFIED directly; it creates EVD, then Verifier/Policy Engine applies status transition after evidence_verifiable.

routing.fallback: ordered compatible providers with identical stage contract
routing.independent_stage_rule: min_distinct_models from stage fanout is mandatory

observability.raw_outputs: stored encrypted/secured per deployment policy; never source of truth
observability.replay: All deterministic transitions must replay from committed events + manifest version.

contractTests.given: IDEA + complete selection answers + available models/tools
stage12 finds blocking A2 product gap

contractTests.expect: bounded repair with same snapshot; no commit before valid
2+ distinct models, identical snapshot hash, no sibling visibility
HTSK/WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_TEST; only HRES+AEV can produce HUMAN_TEST EVD
CHG + downstream stale propagation + minimal rerun

contractTests.given: manual checklist says pass but validator fails
contractTests.expect: gate fail; checklist ignored as authority
zero partial mutations; retry idempotent by run_id

breaking_changes: RegistryEntry wrapper is canonical source for id/version/status/blocking/provenance.
id@v replaced by object_id + integer version.
Product Concept separated into PCON; CAP reserved for functional capabilities.
Stage string inputs replaced by typed input_selectors.
Manual gate/DOD checkboxes removed as source of truth.
Owner in stages 13/22/30 replaced by active DPL/authority events plus deterministic Policy Engine on normal path.
Stage 9 is explicitly model scenario analysis; HUMAN_TEST is routed through stage25 tasks.
